title: xenoPT: Thermobarometry for mantle xenoliths and xenocrysts
description:
xenoPT computes equilibration pressure-temperature (P-T) estimates for mantle xenoliths and xenocrysts from mineral major-element chemistry, using published thermometers and barometers. It solves any thermometer-barometer pair iteratively, checks which blank oxides each calibration requires, and applies the clinopyroxene suitability tests of Ziberna et al. (2016) and Sudholz et al. (2021) and the orthopyroxene-garnet checks of Nimis & Grutter (2010), reporting any failures as plain-language warnings. Each formula was checked against its original publication.

This code was developed as part of Geoscience Australia's Resourcing Australia's Prosperity initiative and accompanies Hoggard et al. (2026), Paleothermal structure of the Australian continental lithosphere, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems.
